about: The controller's answers to a Forget of an automatic lane switch (POST cmd/sitemgr {"cmd": "delete-device", "mac": <its MAC>}), Network 11.0.99, the DX010's cage 26, 2026-11-18 (docs/drivers/breakout.md 16.13). Status and meta only: the answer's data holds the whole stored record, x_authkey included, and was never kept. data_records is how many records data held. state is the record's state in stat/device when it was asked.
